scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.prestart: sh -c 'pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push || { echo "[warn] db push failed — continuing start so Autoscale can serve HTTP" >&2; exit 0; }'
scripts.test: pnpm run test:typecheck-refresh && pnpm run test:launch && pnpm run test:marketplace-safety && pnpm run test:sponsor-reservations && pnpm run test:splash-reservations && pnpm run test:public-buying && pnpm run test:ucp-proof-performance && pnpm run test:concierge && pnpm run test:editorial && pnpm run test:editorial-api
scripts.test:launch: esbuild ./tests/launch.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/launch.test.mjs --external:pg-native --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' && NODE_ENV=test node /tmp/launch.test.mjs
scripts.test:marketplace-safety: esbuild ./tests/marketplace-safety.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/marketplace-safety.test.mjs --external:pg-native --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' && node /tmp/marketplace-safety.test.mjs
scripts.test:sponsor-reservations: esbuild ./tests/sponsorReservations.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=./dist/sponsor-reservations.test.mjs --external:pg-native --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' && NODE_ENV=production node ./dist/sponsor-reservations.test.mjs
